excluded_claims.SEC-02-2-C-008: Two-phase steel-fibre application to minimise rebound. Optional enrichment; overlaps subsection C without adding required coverage.
excluded_claims.SEC-02-2-C-010: Repair-work cover thicknesses over reinforcement. A different construction activity from this section's subject.
excluded_claims.SEC-02-2-C-011: Repair-work thicknesses without reinforcement. Same reason as SEC-02-2-C-010.
excluded_claims.SEC-02-2-C-013: Steel mesh bar counts - reinforcement, not shotcrete material or application.
excluded_claims.SEC-02-2-C-014: Steel mesh bar counts - reinforcement, not shotcrete material or application.
excluded_claims.SEC-02-2-C-015: Steel mesh types - reinforcement, not shotcrete material or application.
excluded_claims.SEC-02-2-C-016: Steel mesh dimensions and TS 4559 - reinforcement, not shotcrete.
excluded_claims.SEC-02-2-C-017: A single mine's mesh specification. Site-specific practice, not a requirement; qualified as such on the allowlist.
excluded_claims.SEC-02-2-P0-002: The 360 kg/m³ general-concrete maximum from Tablo-308-23-b. Allowlisted, composition-safe and SUPPORTED_CONTEXT - required for no topic. Its only safe rendering is a sentence stating at length that the figure does not govern shotcrete, and handing it to a writer drafting a shotcrete section invites exactly the misattribution CF-P0-001 exists to prevent, for no coverage gain. The enforcement machinery is exercised by the fixtures and required unit tests instead, where being wrong costs nothing.
excluded_claims.SEC-02-2-R025: Flashcrete's status as non-active support. Correct and cited, but it introduces a support category this section does not otherwise define.

section_goal: Set out, for a tunnel-engineering reader, what the specifications require of shotcrete as a material and of its application: the binding strength class and its acceptance criteria, the cement dosage minimums by system, the layer thicknesses and their sequence, and the conditions that govern when a layer may follow another.
section_title: Püskürtme Beton: Malzeme ve Uygulama Gereklilikleri

semantic_constraints.forbidden_meaning: Tablo-351-5 establishes or defines the minimum C25/30 strength class.
semantic_constraints.required_action: State Tablo-351-5 as what it is - the acceptance criteria for the class - and state the class requirement itself from SEC-02-2-C-001, in its own sentence.
semantic_constraints.required_meaning: Tablo-351-5 provides 28-day core-sample acceptance criteria for C25/30 shotcrete.

safe_relationship.rule: Both claims may be stated, separately. The draft must not imply that SEC-02-2-C-002 proves SEC-02-2-C-001; no approved relationship supports that inference.

subsections.goal: Establish the strength class the specification binds, and the acceptance criteria by which it is verified.
subsections.title: Püskürtme Betonun Malzeme ve Dayanım Gereklilikleri

subsections.goal: State the dry- and wet-system cement minimums with their systems named, the durability floor, and the approval-bound reduction for special applications.
subsections.title: Çimento Dozajı

subsections.goal: Give the typical initial-lining thickness range, the single-pass maximum, and the layer sequence from first to subsequent layers.
subsections.title: Kaplama Kalınlığı ve Katman Düzeni

subsections.goal: Cover the strength precondition for the next layer, the accelerator-free waiting time, and the clay-zone first-layer case.
subsections.title: Uygulama Koşulları ve Özel Durumlar
